question_text: An X is a glass ball the size of a large marble. In its default state (when nobody is touching it), X is full of white smoke. When picked up and held in a person’s hand, X will glow scarlet if there’s something the person has forgotten. X is a banned for use in the examination hall, along with other items such as an Auto-answer Quill. ID X.

The Calydonian boar hunt is one of the great heroic adventures in Greek legend. In an annual celebration, King Oeneus of Calydon forgot to honour X - the Goddess of the Hunt. In anger, she sent the Calydonian boar, a monstrous wild boar that ravaged the land, cattle, and people, and prevented the crops from being sown.
ID the Greek goddess, X, after whom the protagonist of a best-selling fantasy series is also named.

Gongoozling is a hobby, much like Trainspotting. The word may have arisen from words in Lincolnshire dialect: gawn and gooze, both meaning to stare or gape. Some of the more notable locations where gongoozlers like to gather are Foxton Locks in Leicestershire, Caen Hill Flight in Wiltshire, and Fonserannes Locks in Southern France. What is the subject of this hobby?

Earl Rogers was an American trial lawyer and professor. As a defense counsel, Rogers handled 77 murder trials and lost three, out of 183 acquittals over his career with fewer than 20 convictions, even though most of his clients were actually guilty. One of his most important skills was his acting, which was rehearsed to appear spontaneous before the jury. After any particularly damaging testimony by a prosecution witness, he would rise and create a scene, inevitably being warned of contempt by the court, but making the jury forget the point of evidence that had been made minutes earlier. What or who did Earl Rogers inspire?

X is the world's largest international tournament in a certain “sport”, and one of the largest annual international student events. The 2014 edition of the tournament was held at Rajalakshmi Engineering College, Chennai, with Harvard winning the event. The competition was marred by several controversies, including a strike by the judges for non-payment of travel expenses, threat of deportation for Pakistani participants, and socials being held at a theme park with reported “highest deaths per year in the world”. ID X, the competition.

The song "The Day The Nazi Died" by Chumbawamba is a political and social commentary exploring the persistent presence of fascist ideologies. The lyrics delve into the ongoing existence of these ideologies even after World War II, challenging the conventional narrative that suggests the Nazis disappeared after their defeat.
The lyrics mention Spandau Prison, and its last prisoner, X. After X’s death in August 1987, the prison was demolished and replaced by a shopping centre to prevent it from becoming a neo-Nazi shrine. ID X, the last of the Spandau Seven.

Moe Berg was an American Professional Baseball Player, who played 15 seasons in the Major Leagues. However, he is better known for his work during WWII, for the OSS (Office of Strategic Services). One of his missions was to attend a lecture by Werner Heisenberg, and determine if the Germans were close to developing an atomic bomb. Berg befriended Heisenberg and determined Germany were not close.
In 1994, his biography was published - X: The Mysterious Life of Moe Berg. X was also adapted into a 2018 film, with Paul Rudd playing Moe Berg. ID X, which is also a play on the title of a famous American novel.

X (1972) is an American adult animated black comedy film, written and directed by Ralph Bakshi, and based on Robert Crumb's comic strip of the same name. Due to the film’s depiction of profanity, extreme violence, sex, nudity, anti-religious humor, smoking, drinking and drug use, the film became the first animated American film to be Rated X. Made on a budget of $700,000, it grossed $90 Million worldwide, making it one of the most successful independent films of all time. The film's use of satire and mature themes is seen as paving the way for future animated works for adults, including The Simpsons, South Park and Family Guy. ID the film X.

X is a fictional character in the Star Wars franchise, first appearing in the 1983 film Return of the Jedi, although X is also mentioned in the A New Hope, and The Empire Strikes Back. He is a large, slug-like crime lord of the ____ species,  who lives in a palace on the desert planet Tatooine.
Nilo Rodis-Jamero, the costume designer for Return of the Jedi, said he had envisioned X as a refined, intelligent man resembling Y. Y was an American Actor and Filmmaker whose fondness for rich foods and whiskey led him to become obese by his mid 30’s.
ID X and Y.

Person of Interest is an American science fiction crime drama television series, created by Jonathan Nolan. The 10th episode of the fourth season of the show is titled “The Cold War”, and was originally aired on December 16, 2014. In the episode, the characters - Jeremy Lambert, Root, Martine Rousseau, and John Reese - are caught in a tricky situation. How is this scene familiar to people who have never seen the show?

In the 10th episode of the 12th season of Last Week Tonight with John Oliver, originally airing on May 4, 2025, one of the segments looked at Minor League Baseball, and the team names and marketing in the league. The segment ended with an open call and offer by John Oliver to fully rebrand one Minor League team.
More than 40 Minor League clubs reached out, and the show later selected the Erie SeaWolves. The new name was chosen as XY, based on a bit of Erie lore, where a local diver named George X, had discovered remains of a ______ Y in Lake Pleasant, in 1991. The lore inspired the space-themed name and mascot which were unveiled later in July. ID XY.

X is an American brand that was established in 1915. In 2020, the company hired Terence Reilly, formerly of Crocs, as its president. Following the hire, the sale of their most popular product, Quenchers, which were re-branded as XY rose by 275%.
The brand also experienced renewed interest and popularity, especially among Gen-Z.
ID XY, the brand’s most popular product.

The X National Liberation Front is a socialist political party in Nicaragua. Its members are called Xs. The party is named after Augusto César ________, who led the Nicaraguan resistance against the United States occupation of Nicaragua in the 1930s. In the 1980’s, a US backed group, known as the Contras, was formed to overthrow the X government, funded and trained by the CIA. Once this was discovered, it became a huge controversy for the Reagan administration. ID X.

X is a Joint Secretary level position in the Indian Administration Services. The department was established after the Indo-Pakistan War of 1965, under a 1968 act, amended later in 2017. The office of the X is located in Delhi, with branch offices of the department in Mumbai, Calcutta and Lucknow. The current X is Mr. Rahul Ramesh Nangare. ID X.

The book chronicles his life as a tennis champion, social activist, and his battle with AIDS, reflecting his courage and grace. X is believed to have acquired HIV from a blood transfusion he received during heart bypass surgery in 1983. He publicly announced his illness in April 1992, and began working to educate others about HIV and AIDS.
ID X.

The startup has a pilot project set up in Södertälje, a city near Stockholm, and aims to save nearly 75 percent of the costs of clean up that the city spends annually.
